name: a2a
title: A2A
role: Transport that carries x402 and MPP payments in `SendMessage`, including through the x402 extension.
subset: Agent Card, `SendMessage` with `returnImmediately`, `GetTask`, `ListTasks`, `CancelTask` and the paid flow; the x402 extension is experimental

exclusions.name: resuming a background task after a restart
exclusions.note: A task the gateway stopped in reads as failed; any payment is in the gateway records.

exclusions.name: task resumption other than an x402 extension payment
client-chosen contextId
exclusions.note: A `contextId` without a task gets `UnsupportedOperationError`; each new task opens a context the gateway generates.

exclusions.name: listing tasks across contexts
exclusions.note: `ListTasks` reads only the given `contextId`; without one, the page is empty.

exclusions.name: task history
exclusions.note: Tasks omit `history`; `historyLength` is validated but has nothing to cap.

exclusions.name: file and URL parts (including inline bytes)
artifact types beyond Agent Commerce outcome data
tasks across gateway instances
exclusions.note: Instances with separate receipt stores cannot read, cancel or pay each other's tasks.

deviations.summary: A `ListTasks` page with no matching task has an empty `tasks` array. The proto marks `tasks` REQUIRED, and §5.7 requires a REQUIRED array to hold an element, but an empty result has none to return.

conformance.suite: Our tests against the A2A 1.0.1 specification, and the A2A TCK at MUST level in CI.
